title: Peak-Then-Collapse and the Four Interface Channels of Knowledge-Graph Tool Use
abstract: arXiv:2605.26037v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We test the standard RLVR tool-use recipe -- GRPO on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct -- on a deliberately minimal knowledge-graph tool API: four Freebase navigation verbs over Complex WebQuestions. Under a self-verifiable retrieval reward, the policy's tool-grounded answer rate climbs from $3.8\%$ to $9.6\%$ over 250 steps, then collapses to $0\%$ within a single 50-step window -- a \emph{peak-then-collapse} pattern replicated across four seeds. Across seven reward designs, we find four recurring failure modes: adding denser or more targeted proxy rewards shifts the failure mode rather than eliminating it. We argue that a key difference from Python interpreters, web search, and JSON APIs is interface feedback: their failures often leak natural-language signal the model saw in pretraining. translated_title: 先峰值后崩溃：知识图谱工具使用的四条接口通道
translated_abstract: 我们在一个刻意极简的知识图谱工具API上测试了标准的RLVR工具使用配方——即在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上运行GRPO，该API仅包含基于Complex WebQuestions数据集的四个Freebase导航动词。在可自我验证的检索奖励下，策略的工具化答案率在250步内从3.8%攀升至9.6%，随后在单个50步窗口内崩溃至0%——这种“先峰值后崩溃”模式在四个随机种子上均得到复现。通过对七种奖励设计的实验，我们发现了四种反复出现的失败模式：添加更密集或更有针对性的代理奖励只会转移失败模式，而无法消除它。我们认为，与Python解释器、网页搜索和JSON API的一个关键区别在于接口反馈：这些工具的失败往往会泄露模型在预训练中见过的自然语言信号。Python的回溯信息会指明出错的代码行，而Freebase的空结果[]则不会。剥离这层表面后，暴露出一种此前被掩盖的退化机制……
tldr: 该论文发现在极简知识图谱工具API上进行RLVR训练会出现“先峰值后崩溃”现象，其与Python解释器等工具的关键区别在于接口反馈是否泄露自然语言信号，且更密集的代理奖励只能转移而非消除四种反复出现的失败模式。
en_tdlr: RLVR training on a minimal knowledge-graph tool API exhibits a peak-then-collapse pattern, and unlike Python interpreters or web search, the absence of natural-language interface feedback exposes four recurring failure modes that denser proxy rewards merely shift rather than eliminate.
